result.stdout:
Description:
  Terminal UI for browsing Azure Service Bus namespaces, queues, topics, and messages

Usage:
  azsb [command] [options]

Options:
  -s, --subscription <subscription>  Azure subscription to start in, by name or ID; emulator for the local emulator
  -n, --namespace <namespace>        Namespace of that subscription to open, by name or host name; needs --subscription
  -o, --open <open>                  Queue, topic or topic/subscription of that namespace to open, by exact name; /dlq or /active picks the tab. Or a list: queues, topics or subscriptions. Needs --namespace
  -t, --theme <theme>                Colors for a dark or light terminal background: auto (default; COLORFGBG, else dark), dark or light; overrides ui.theme
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information
  --version                          Show version information

Commands:
  run                                             Open the terminal UI (the default command)
  config <get|list|path|set|unset> <key> <value>  Read and write settings in the config file, like git config:
                                                    get <key>: print a value, exit code 1 when unset; unset <key>: remove it
                                                    set <key> <value>: true/false and integers are stored as such, the rest as text
                                                    list [--all]: print key=value lines, secrets masked; path: print the config file's path
  plugins                                         List the plugins, whether they are enabled, and their settings
  help <command>                                  Show help for azsb or one of its commands

    set <key> <value>: true/false and integers are stored as such, the rest as text

Usage:
  azsb config <action> [<key> [<value>]] [options]

  <get|list|path|set|unset>  get, set, unset, list or path

  <value>                    Value to set

Options:
  --all           With list: also the known keys that are unset, with their default and description
